clips.title: The story
paras: Rahauro is a tauren attendant found on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, faithfully serving the elder crone Magatha Grimtotem. Acting on her behalf, he recruits brave adventurers to venture into the volcanic depths of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. He coordinates efforts to retaliate against the hostile troggs and recover missing possessions belonging to his mistress's fallen agents.

Standing loyally near Magatha Grimtotem on the high terrace of Elder Rise, Rahauro acts as her direct intermediary. Magatha often operates through trusted underlings rather than soiling her own hooves with public recruitment. When reports emerge of wild creatures swarming beneath the orcish capital, it is Rahauro who handles the logistical details, dispatching Horde mercenaries to deal with the uprising.

The troggs infesting the subterranean caverns of Ragefire Chasm did not respond kindly to diplomatic outreach. Magatha originally dispatched envoys in an attempt to forge peace with the primitive beasts, but the troggs turned violently on the delegates and butchered them. Viewing them as an intolerable threat to the Horde, Rahauro directs champions into the caverns to cull the troggs and assess their true strength.
